title: GI-Tagged Mithila Makhana Makes First Sea Shipment to Australia
summary: India completed its first-ever sea export of Geographical Indication (GI)-tagged Mithila Makhana from Bihar to Australia in August 2026. The consignment was flagged off from the Integrated Unit of Irradiation-cum-Packhouse in the Sikandarpu...

blocks.content: India completed its first-ever sea export of Geographical Indication (GI)-tagged Mithila Makhana from Bihar to Australia in August 2026. The consignment was flagged off from the Integrated Unit of Irradiation-cum-Packhouse in the Sikandarpur industrial area of Bihta near Patna and was routed through Kolkata for sea transport.

items: Geographical Indication tags are granted in India under the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999.
APEDA was established under an Act of Parliament and functions under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
Makhana is commonly called fox nut or lotus seed in English.
Bihta is located near Patna in Bihar and has an inland dry port facility.
